text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy's legs are developing<n>well and her
popularity is rising. It's<n>about time she starts taking
on races<n>in earnest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants to embrace evil in her<n>races so that
people will fear her for<n>the next hundred years. In
other<n>words, she wants to make her mark.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has found a new ambition—to<n>become a legend
strong enough to<n>top the rankings even a hundred
years from now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But first, she'll need to rack up some<n>victories. Her
next objective is the<n>Unicorn Stakes, a graded race
with<n>similar conditions to that of her debut.
